newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt quarry blast kills nine miners.
newsitem.headline: Egypt quarry blast kills nine miners.

text.p: Nine Egyptian miners were killed and another severely injured on Thursday after a blast ripped through an alabaster quarry in the Sinai, security sources said.
They said an unidentified object exploded while the miners were investigating a vein in the quarry at the Reheinah area, some 45 km (28 miles) from the resort town of Ras Sidr.
The blast caused a deep crater in the quarry and disfigured the bodies beyond identification.
The sources said Egyptian police called in explosive experts to find out whether the object was a mine left over from Egypt's war with Israel or a blasting device used in mining.
